407:t_10:24.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Even I can't think of any words of comfort this time. So I'm skipping the congratulations for the ace pilot this time, too.」

407:t_10:25.en:
$$シェリル$$
「Fine. Right now, let's trust those guys instead of offering clumsy words.」

407:t_10:26.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Agreed. Then I'll do what I can do.」

407:t_10:27.en:
$$シェリル$$
「That's fine, but go easy today.」

407:t_10:29.en:
$$シェリル$$
(I'm counting on you, $$アルト$$. To save both $$ランカ$$-chan and $$エイミー$$.)

407:t_10:30.en:
$$シェリル$$
(Cut through that mist with your wings.)

408:t_000:0.en:
$$オズマ$$
「$$アルト$$ and $$ブレラ$$ as a pair, huh...」

408:t_000:2.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Probably his own way of backing $$ランカ$$ up, don't you think?」

408:t_000:4.en:
$$宗介$$
(Major $$オズマ$$ is pretty dry about $$アルト$$'s love triangle.)

408:t_000:5.en:
$$キラ$$
(He used to be very wary of any man who got close to $$ランカ$$, though.)

408:t_000:6.en:
$$シン$$
(What's wrong with that? It's only natural for a big brother to worry about his little sister.)

408:t_000:11.en:
$$オズマ$$
「All units, here they come! Prepare to intercept!」

408:t_001:0.en:
$$バナージ$$
「That unit...! It's $$ギルター・ベローネ$$!」

408:t_001:1.en:
$n
「$$ギルター$$! Where is Miss $$スズネ$$!?」

408:t_001:2.en:
$$ギルター$$
「I couldn't care less about that!」

408:t_001:4.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Because of you, I was banished to a remote, do-nothing post like this!」

408:t_001:5.en:
$$ギルター$$
「I'll defeat you here and return to the front lines, no matter what!」

408:t_001:6.en:
$$葵$$
「What a pathetic man, through and through.」

408:t_001:7.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「We have no intention of becoming a stepping stone for your promotion!」

408:t_001:8.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「All units, begin combat. We'll hit them here and wipe out the $$サイデリアル$$ in the $$残されの海$$.」

408:t_001:9.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
(Fleet Commander $$フェアロック$$... I'll settle one of your regrets here.)

408:t_001:10.en:
$$アルト$$
「Don't bring your logic into this sea! Let's finish this fast!」

408:t_002:0.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Damn pests...! Why do you keep resisting the $$サイデリアル$$!」

408:t_002:1.en:
$$赤木$$
「What are you talking about! It's because you attacked us!」

408:t_002:2.en:
$$クロウ$$
「We love freedom and peace. If you want to take that away, we'll take you on as many times as it takes.」

408:t_002:3.en:
$$ギルター$$
「You never stop running your mouths!」

408:t_004:0.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Tch, interlopers! I'm going home!」

408:t_005:1.en:
$$宗介$$
「Dealing with the $$バジュラ$$ comes first now!」

408:t_005:2.en:
$$シモン$$
「But their color is different from the ones we know!」

408:t_005:3.en:
$$甲児$$
「And there are also the unmanned fighters the $$ギャラクシー船団$$ used!」

408:t_005:4.en:
$$オズマ$$
「Careful! It seems those $$バジュラ$$ are part of the $$ギャラクシー船団$$'s forces!」

408:t_005:5.en:
$$竜馬$$
「So those guys were still alive!」

408:t_005:6.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「It seems they've developed technology to control the $$バジュラ$$.」

408:t_005:7.en:
$$葵$$
「They can actually do something like that...!」

408:t_005:8.en:
$$ジョニー$$
「Could the difference in body color be an effect of that?」

408:t_009:0.en:
$$オズマ$$
「Don't get careless and approach, $$アルト$$!」

408:t_010:1.en:
$$アルト$$
「$$ブレラ$$! Are you being controlled by them again!?」

408:t_010:2.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「I am $$アンタレス$$ 1. A soldier of the $$ギャラクシー船団$$.」

408:t_013:0.en:
$$レド$$
「I will cover you. Let us regroup.」

408:t_014:1.en:
$$カナリア$$
「$$ブレラ$$ was originally one of the $$ギャラクシー船団$$'s people. He underwent $$インプラント$$ surgery there.」

408:t_014:2.en:
$$カナリア$$
「Most likely a system to control his mind was built in at that time.」

408:t_014:3.en:
$$クラン$$
「But that should have been destroyed when $$アルト$$ shot him down in the $$再世戦争$$...!」

408:t_014:4.en:
$$ルカ$$
「A backup system... or a stronger control line prepared for emergencies, I would think.」

408:t_014:5.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「What will you do, Captain $$ジェフリー$$?」

408:t_014:6.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「There's no sign of coordination between the $$ギャラクシー船団$$ and the $$サイデリアル$$, but both are targeting us.」

408:t_014:7.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「At this rate we'll be caught in a pincer attack...!」

408:t_014:8.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「All units, intercept the $$バジュラ$$. As for $$ブレラ・スターン$$, try to neutralize him as far as possible.」

408:t_014:11.en:
$$アルト$$
「$$レド$$... I'll ask what happened to you later. Right now, lend me your strength.」

408:t_014:13.en:
$$アルト$$
「No...! I'm going to stop him...! For $$ランカ$$'s sake, too!」

408:t_014:14.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「Let's do this, $$バサラ$$! Our song will reach even those $$バジュラ$$!」
